info.about: Gungrave: Overdose is a PlayStation 2 third-person shooter video game developed by animation studio Ikusabune and published by Red Entertainment in Japan and by Mastiff in North America, and a direct sequel to Gungrave. The game was released on March 4, 2004, in Japan, September 15, 2004, in North America and October 7, 2005, in the PAL regions.
info.trivia: A budget-priced sequel that sold for twenty dollars at launch.
info.why: Printed in smaller numbers than the first game and never re-released, so it prices above it.
